From the diagram, we see that $f(x)$ has roots ${x}_{1,2}=\pm 2\text{i}$  and ${x}_{3,4}=1\pm \text{i}.$ Additionally, we're given that the coefficient of the quartic term is $a=3.$ Therefore, we can write the polynomial as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(x) & =a(x-{x}_{1})(x-{x}_{2})(x-{x}_{3})(x-{x}_{4}) \\  & =3(x-2\text{i})(x-(-2\text{i}))(x-(1+\text{i}))(x-(1-\text{i})) \\  & =3(x-2\text{i})(x+2\text{i})(x-(1+\text{i}))(x-(1-\text{i}))\end{aligned}
$$

Expanding the parentheses, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}3(x-2\text{i})(x+2\text{i})(x-(1+\text{i}))(x-(1-\text{i})) & = \\ 3({x}^{2}+2\text{i}x-2\text{i}x-(2\text{i})^{2})({x}^{2}-x(1-\text{i})-x(1+\text{i})+(1+\text{i})(1-\text{i})) & = \\ 3({x}^{2}+4)({x}^{2}-2x+2) & = \\ 3({x}^{4}-2{x}^{3}+2{x}^{2}+4{x}^{2}-8x+8) & = \\ 3({x}^{4}-2{x}^{3}+6{x}^{2}-8x+8) & = \\ 3{x}^{4}-6{x}^{3}+18{x}^{2}-24x+24 & .\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $f(x)=3{x}^{4}-6{x}^{3}+18{x}^{2}-24x+24\,.$
